rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold-span inventory re-run this session (grep -noE '\*\*[^*]+\*\*' over the raw file, filtered to lines 104-146 — unchanged since the last two passes, the file's only edits since have landed at lines 13 and the post-maintainer-cut Quality line, neither inside these chunks): chunk 8 (Skill stacking, lines 104-134) still carries eight content-bold spans on one slide — seven bulleted leads (line 117 'A single orchestrator', 118 'Phase-organised skill catalogue.', 119 'Design principles', 123 'Front-loaded read-only analysis.', 124 'Mandatory gates fire positionally', 125 'Re-invocation as control flow.', 126 'CLAUDE.md as half the system.') plus one inline handle (line 128 'scales cross-repo'). None is a §34 task-sizing callout, a module-template LO bullet, or content on a reading-list/menu/lookup surface (this is a narrative worked-example section) — the per-slide COUNT is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture the rule bans. Chunk 9 (How to pick what to study, lines 135-146): three bold spans (line 139 'What shape is your real work?' — 6 words; line 141 'How much orchestration do you want to author?' — 8 words; line 143 'What review bandwidth do you have?' — 6 words) each bold the FULL question of its filter entry, exceeding the ≲5-word handle cap; none is a coined term or named law. Considered and rejected as a covered reading-list/menu waiver: that waiver lifts the per-slide COUNT but explicitly keeps the handle-length cap, and names this exact failure ('Bolding mode-plus-title is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture wearing a list for cover') — here the whole question is bolded with the answer prose left plain, i.e. mode-plus-title with no plain title at all. Harm: on a slide carrying no size accept-note that would exempt it, three consecutive full-sentence bolds flatten the bold signal into noise — a reader scanning for the slide's one handle finds three, none a named concept, while the actual navigational cue (which practitioner to read) sits in plain prose at the end of each entry. Unchanged across three consecutive slides passes now (bodies @e11bbeb4, @0cea7581-prior, current @bb14be28); still un-actioned per standing orchestrator instruction — re-confirmed live rather than carried forward blind.
